# Harborview Law

> Harborview Law (Harbor View Law, P.C.) provides outside general counsel and
> concierge legal solutions for businesses from Newport Beach, California.
> Founded by Jim Grass, an attorney with 25+ years advising C-suite executives
> in public and private companies, the firm offers personalized, on-demand
> legal support in corporate law, real estate, commercial contracts,
> telecommunications, and risk management.

Contact: +1 (949) 791-7764 · info@harborviewlaw.com
Office: 23 Corporate Plaza Drive, Suite 150, Newport Beach, CA 92660

## Practice Areas

- [All Practice Areas](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-areas): Overview of the firm's services for businesses
- [General Counsel Services](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/general-counsel-services): Fractional/outside general counsel for corporate governance, compliance, and risk management
- [Corporate Law](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/corporate-law): Entity formation, governance, restructuring, and joint ventures
- [Commercial Contracts & Transactions](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/commercial-contracts-transactions): Drafting, review, and negotiation of business-critical agreements
- [Real Estate Law](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/real-estate-law): Property transactions, leases, entitlements, and zoning
- [Telecommunications](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/telecommunications): Telecom leases, right-of-way and easement agreements for property owners
- [Legal Consultation](https://www.harborviewlaw.com/practice-area/legal-consultation): Practical legal advice for day-to-day business operations
